newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rights group raps Iran over execution of lawyer.
newsitem.headline: Rights group raps Iran over execution of lawyer.

text.p: A human rights association criticised Iran on Tuesday for executing a former lawyer on charges of taking part in a 1980 coup attempt and visiting Israel before Iran's 1979 Islamic revolution.
The International Federation of Human Rights Leagues (FIDH) said Mohammed Assadi, also accused by his government of being a freemason, was executed last Saturday in Tehran.
FIDH said Assadi had not had a fair trial and urged the international community to use all available means to end alleged human rights violations in Iran.
The Paris-based FIDH groups 89 national human rights leagues.
